inputs.text: Locked off full-scale construction site documentary photograph in motion. The camera looks horizontally at one excavated trench wall next to an existing paved sidewalk. The upper edge of the image shows a narrow strip of rectangular concrete sidewalk pavers, below them a thin continuous layer of beige bedding sand and a thicker layer of compacted angular gray aggregate, with undisturbed brown soil underneath. A single gray drainage pipe is exposed in the lower soil with the round hollow opening facing the camera. A small irregular gap in the soil alongside the pipe. Real earthen trench extends outside the frame: no cutaway block, no floor below the pipe. A few small soil grains fall from the cavity. The rest of the scene and camera remain still, natural daylight, realistic textures and scale.
